lastSession.summary: Implemented marky-v8r: heading_scan SIMD kernel — first real markymark extraction kernel. Created scalar reference (heading_scan_ref.zig) and SIMD implementation (heading_scan.zig) using @Vector(16, u8) for 16-byte newline scanning. Added marky_scan_headings C ABI export to c_adapter.zig with null/cap validation. 13 kernel tests + 4 scalar tests + 5 c_adapter tests all passing. SIMD benchmark shows ~1.9x speedup over scalar on 10KB markdown. Committed and pushed (ac79fac).
